text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from the information provided

An all-male panel is worth questioning, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications are strong; the announcement alone cannot establish how the candidates compared against the selection criteria.

Raise panel composition neutrally alongside a follow-up request for the written reasons, assessment criteria, and your scores or comparative assessment, where disclosable. Ask whether any rules on panel gender balance applied and were followed.

Two weeks’ silence is a reason to follow up, not evidence of discrimination. Check local complaint deadlines now; waiting for reasons may not extend them. Your country’s law will determine your rights and available remedies.
